name: e1x_breakeven_noopen
description: e1x_breakeven without the 09:30:00 decision (skip_open), on the same five seeds: how much of the cost and the break-even comes from trading into the opening cross. Not a paired comparison: a skip_open run starts each day's grid at 09:35, so every held book is formed five minutes later than in e1x_breakeven (the day's last formation, which earns nothing past the close, at 15:50 rather than 15:45), and the oracle noise is drawn afresh over the shorter grid. A break-even shift is therefore read against both runs' seed ranges (appendix.py writes lookup_noopen.csv and open_effect.csv), not on its own. 35 tasks of 30 configurations: roughly 25 minutes on 4 cores.
